name: Marion LaRue
source:
Marion is an elemental magic student who earned her scholarship at LeFay Academy through meticulous self-study. Fiery, rebellious, and carefree, Marion is not one to back down from a challenge. As one of LeFay's brightest students, she aims to prove her worth and earn her place as a respectable mage despite her common background. But when it comes to friendship and teamwork, Marion still has a long way to go.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yangyangmobile/perfect-gold]Kickstarter[/url]]
